sentences.text:
As per prosecution case, co-accused Raja Kumar Sah, who is friend of the brother of complainant,
established physical relation with the complainant several times on pretext of marriage and when she became pregnant, co-accused Raja Kumar Sah solemnized marriage with the complainant.

Thereafter, when complainant went to her matrimonial house, she was tortured and harassed and abused by caste name by the F.I.R. named accused persons including these appellants and was ousted from her matrimonial house.
5. Learned counsel for the appellants submits that appellants are innocent and have committed no offence.
Specific accusation is against co-accused Raja Kumar Sah.

Appellant No. 1 is father,
appellant No. 2 is mother, appellant No. 3 is brother and appellant No. 4 is brother-in-law of co-accused Raja Kumar Sah
and they are simply victims of over implication.
There is ordinate delay of five months in lodging the F.I.R. which itself creates doubt over veracity of the prosecution case.
Allegation is general and omnibus and there is no specific allegation of overt act against these appellants.
Moreover, it is not the case of Patna High Court CR.

APP (SJ) No.2765 of 2024(4)
dt.10-04-2025 informant that alleged incident occurred within public view, as such, no offence under SC/ST Act is made out against the appellants.
6. Learned Spl. Public Prosecutor for the State vehemently opposed the bail application.

7. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, let the appellants, as named above,
in the event of their arrest/surrender within a period of eight weeks from today, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail-bonds of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Special Judge, SC/ST Act, Purnia in connection with SC/ST P.S. Case No.
10 of 2024 arising out of Complaint Case No. 87 of 2023.
8.
Accordingly, this criminal appeal is allowed and impugned order dated 17.05.2024 is set aside with respect to these appellants only.

(Prabhat Kumar Singh, J) Navya/-
